messages:
Maya - Support: FYI customer reporting intermittent 403s in Console after SSO token refresh. Repro steps they gave:
- Log in via Okta SSO
- Switch org from AcmeCorp -> AcmeCorp-Prod
- Switch project -> 403 Forbidden
Happens ~1-2x/day since yesterday. No console UI errors before switch. Any immediate ideas?

Nick - Support: Have the customer captured a request id or trace for a failing attempt? Also is this only in Chrome?

Maya - Support: They sent a screenshot and one trace id: tr-0a9b7c3e. Browser is Chrome and Firefox both. Impacting one tenant (AcmeCorp) prod org. Severity flagged as high by CSM.

auth-bot: auth-proxy: WARNING session-refresh detected for org AcmeCorp at 2026-03-08T09:12:27Z (trace tr-0a9b7c3e)

Devon - Eng: Thanks. I pulled logs for tr-0a9b7c3e. Sequence looks like:
- oauth-exchange success -> issue new session cookie
- console API call /v1/projects/list returns 403 when Authorization header contains new session id
Auth service returns 200 on token introspect but auth-proxy maps claim x-org -> missing for ~300ms after refresh. Basically a race between token issuance and SCIM/group sync cache refresh.

Jules - SRE: I can confirm spike of 403s for that org around 09:12-09:14 UTC. Stacktrace shows auth-proxy returned 403 with reason "missing_org_claim" in header. Also saw SCIM-cache eviction events at same time due to group rename job.

Devon - Eng: Probable root cause: token minted before group membership hydrated into cache. When console verifies project-level RBAC it expects x-org claim -> if missing we return 403. Short term mitigation: we can catch missing_org_claim on console route and trigger a single retry after 250ms to let cache warm.

Maya - Support: Suggest we give customer a workaround in meantime? They asked for immediate unblock steps.

Devon - Eng: Workaround: ask customer to refresh the browser (full reload) after SSO sign-in, or wait ~1s after sign-in before switching orgs. For a server side workaround we can enable retry logic as above.

Nick - Support: I'll pass workaround to CSM and mark escalation. Creating internal ticket INF-4921 and CC @oncall.

Jules - SRE: I'll schedule a short-lived patch on auth-proxy to retry auth lookup for fresh sessions (feature flag) and monitor. If that reduces hits we can roll to prod and follow up with a permanent fix around SCIM hydration ordering. :thumbsup:

Devon - Eng: Patch plan: feature flag gated, retry up to 2 times with exponential backoff (250ms -> 500ms), add metrics auth.missing_org_claim.retry_count. I'll open PR and link here.

Maya - Support: Thanks team. I'll update customer with workaround + ETA for engineer patch. Leaving thread open until PR merged or customer confirms resolution. :pray:
